summary: Saint Peter was the first among the apostles and became the visible head of the Church. His faith, leadership, and repentance stand as a witness to Christ’s mercy.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Peter as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Peter, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
